summary: This Form 8-K, filed by STRATS Trust for Dominion Resources, Inc. Securities, Series 2005-6, reports a routine distribution to certificate holders on June 15, 2026. The filing includes a trustee's distribution statement as an exhibit and provides standard disclosures regarding the issuer of the underlying securities, Dominion Resources, Inc. No transaction, corporate action, or special situation is described; the 8-K is filed solely to satisfy periodic reporting requirements for an asset-backed security trust. No deal terms, changes in control, or strategic initiatives are present.
